title: Huckleberry Sleep Log Status Mix
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=huckleberry:sleep
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(sleep_quality,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Huckleberry sleep log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `sleep_quality` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your Huckleberry sleep log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
